assets.description: Official LEGO brand logo featuring the word 'LEGO' in white italicized lettering with black outline, surrounded by a bright yellow border, set against a solid red background. The registered trademark symbol (®) appears in the top right. This is a clean, vectorized mark suitable for brand lockup and header placement.

Lifestyle scene featuring three smiling children holding LEGO Pokémon SMART Play sets (Charizard and Mewtwo visible as white/purple articulated figures with motion rings) against a bright yellow background textured with LEGO brick studs. The Pokémon logo appears at top in blue and yellow; a blue gradient oval frames the center figures. An orange Charizard LEGO set is shown on the left, and the 'SMART PLAY' co-branding badge appears lower right. The composition emphasizes interactive play and collection appeal.
